milestones.name: Obtain Hunter's Journal
milestones.note: Given by The Hunter after speaking to him

milestones.name: Rescue Grub (Hunter area)
milestones.note: Free grub by cutting vines and dropping to acid pool area

milestones.name: Defeat Vengefly King
milestones.note: Optional mini-boss; saving Zote the Mighty is required for him to appear at Colosseum of Fools and Dirtmouth

milestones.name: Save Zote the Mighty
milestones.note: Triggers Vengefly King boss battle; affects Zote's later appearances

milestones.name: Rescue Grub (Moss Knight area)
milestones.note: Defeat Moss Knight to unlock gate and free Grub

milestones.name: Obtain Wanderer's Journal
milestones.note: Found in secret room past breakable wall near Stag Station

milestones.name: Defeat Hornet (Boss)
milestones.note: Hornet retreats and leaves behind Mothwing Cloak

milestones.name: Acquire Mothwing Cloak
milestones.note: Grants dash ability; obtained after defeating Hornet

milestones.name: Find Quirrel at Lake of Unn
milestones.note: NPC resting near small house sub-area

milestones.name: Obtain Thorns of Agony
milestones.note: Charm found in thorn-covered section; requires dash to reach

milestones.name: Defeat Massive Moss Charger
milestones.note: Boss in lower area of Greenpath; requires Mothwing Cloak to reach

milestones.name: Rescue Grub (Durandoo acid pool area)
milestones.note: Pogo on Durandoo shells to cross acid; path left blocked until Mantis Claw obtained

milestones.name: Reach Charm Lover Salubra
milestones.note: Accessible only after obtaining Mothwing Cloak; located near Gruz Mother arena in Forgotten Crossroads

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: vibrant vegetation, acid pools, leafy enemies, thorn structures
zones.note: Main zone of this segment; filled with overgrowth, plant-based enemies, and pools of acid

zones.name: Ancestral Mound
zones.note: Previous area; referenced as origin point and prior Elder Baldur encounter

zones.name: Lake of Unn
zones.note: Sub-area of Greenpath; contains a bench, small house, and Quirrel NPC

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.note: Accessible via Stag Station fast travel; contains Charm Lover Salubra and Grubfather

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.note: Hub town; referenced for charm purchasing and Zote's later appearance

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.note: Referenced as future location where Zote appears if saved

abilities.name: Mothwing Cloak
abilities.grants: Dash movement; traverse gaps, cross acid pools, reach previously inaccessible areas

abilities.name: Thorns of Agony
abilities.grants: Charm: damages enemies when Knight takes damage
abilities.note: Found in thorn-covered eastern section; requires Mothwing Cloak dash to reach

abilities.name: Wanderer's Journal
abilities.note: Found in secret room behind breakable wall near Greenpath Stag Station

abilities.name: Vengeful Spirit
abilities.note: Pre-existing spell used to kill Elder Baldur blocking Greenpath entrance; acquired before this segment

bosses.name: Hornet (Boss)
bosses.note: Fast boss; drops Mothwing Cloak on defeat; fought in arena at end of long corridor

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Optional mini-boss; triggered by saving Zote the Mighty; attacks via battle cry summoning Vengefly and charge attack

bosses.name: Massive Moss Charger
bosses.note: Boss in lower Greenpath; requires Mothwing Cloak to reach; drops Geo on defeat
